settings.name: enableDatabase
settings.label: Enable Media Database
settings.description: Enable e2MDB database/cache integration. Provider and scan work runs in the backend daemon, not in the Enigma2 GUI process.

settings.name: showInMainMenu
settings.label: Show in main menu
settings.description: Add e2MDB to the Enigma2 main menu. The plugin remains available in the plugin browser when this is disabled.

settings.name: scannerRescanExisting
settings.label: Re-scan existing media entries
settings.description: Off keeps existing DB metadata/artwork and only scans new or changed files. On reprocesses existing entries and may download metadata/artwork again.

settings.name: cachePath
settings.label: Cache path
settings.description: Base path for e2MDB cache files, provider artwork, database and generated metadata.

settings.name: webPort
settings.label: Web interface port
settings.description: TCP port used by the e2MDB backend web interface. Default is 6066.

settings.name: lang
settings.label: Provider search language
settings.description: Language used for provider searches and provider API requests.

settings.name: tmdbactive
settings.label: Search in TMDb
settings.description: Use TMDb for movie and series metadata. Recommended as the primary provider.

settings.name: tmdbapikey
settings.label: TMDb API key
settings.description: Enter your personal API key for TMDb.

settings.name: tvdbactive
settings.label: Search in TVDb
settings.description: Use TVDb for series metadata and episode/season artwork.

settings.name: tvdbapikey
settings.label: TVDb API key
settings.description: Enter your personal API key for TVDb.

settings.name: tvmazeactive
settings.label: Search in TVmaze
settings.description: Use TVmaze as a free series fallback provider without API key.

settings.name: cinemetaactive
settings.label: Search in Cinemeta
settings.description: Use Cinemeta (Stremio addon) as a free movie and series fallback provider without API key. English metadata only.

settings.name: tvspielfilmactive
settings.label: Search in TVSpielfilm for German Live/EPG
settings.description: Use TVSpielfilm as preferred provider for German Live/EPG metadata.

settings.name: fernsehserienactive
settings.label: Use fernsehserien.de image fallback for German Live/EPG
settings.description: Use fernsehserien.de as German Live/EPG image fallback.

settings.name: omdbactive
settings.label: Search in OMDb
settings.description: Optional fallback provider. OMDb requires an API key and is not localized.

settings.name: omdbapikey
settings.label: OMDb API key
settings.description: Enter your personal API key for OMDb.

settings.name: animeactive
settings.label: Search in AniList Anime/Manga
settings.description: Use AniList for Anime/Manga path modes.

settings.name: kitsuactive
settings.label: Search in Kitsu Anime/Manga
settings.description: Use Kitsu for Anime/Manga path modes.

settings.name: wikimediaactive
settings.label: Use Wikimedia/Wikipedia image fallback for Live/EPG
settings.description: Use Wikimedia/Wikipedia as Live/EPG fallback artwork provider.

settings.name: fanartactive
settings.label: Use FanArt.tv artwork fallback
settings.description: Use FanArt.tv after another provider matched a movie or series.

settings.name: fanartapikey
settings.label: FanArt.tv API key
settings.description: Enter your personal FanArt.tv API key.

settings.name: fanartmode
settings.label: FanArt.tv artwork mode
settings.description: Fill only missing artwork, or prefer FanArt.tv artwork over artwork from the metadata provider.

settings.name: epgMetaEnabled
settings.label: Enable Live/EPG metadata cache
settings.description: Enable short-lived metadata caching for Live TV and EPG events.

settings.name: epgEventViewUseE2MDB
settings.label: Show e2MDB EventView for EPG events
settings.description: Open the e2MDB EventView for EPG events when metadata exists.

settings.name: mediaEventViewUseE2MDB
settings.label: Show e2MDB EventView for media events
settings.description: Open the e2MDB media EventView for recordings/media when metadata exists.

settings.name: epgInfoBarEnabled
settings.label: Enable InfoBar metadata
settings.description: Attach e2MDB metadata sources to live TV InfoBar and queue missing entries for the backend daemon.

settings.name: epgChannelSelectionEnabled
settings.label: Enable ChannelSelection metadata
settings.description: Attach e2MDB metadata sources to ChannelSelection and queue missing entries for the backend daemon.

settings.name: epgServiceListPreviewMode
settings.label: Service list preview image
settings.description: Select which image type should be preferred for service-list previews.

settings.name: epgRetentionDays
settings.label: Live/EPG retention in days
settings.description: Keep matched Live/EPG metadata for this number of days after the event ended.

settings.name: epgNoMatchRetentionHours
settings.label: No-match retention in hours
settings.description: Keep no-match Live/EPG entries for this number of hours after the event ended.

settings.name: epgPrefillEnabled
settings.label: Enable Live/EPG prefill
settings.description: Queue future EPG events for selected/preferred channels so the backend can process them overnight.

settings.name: epgPrefillMode
settings.label: Prefill mode
settings.description: Night window is recommended for backend-only processing.

settings.name: epgPrefillStartHour
settings.label: Night prefill start hour
settings.description: Hour of day used for night prefill checks.

settings.name: epgPrefillHorizonDays
settings.label: Live/EPG prefill days
settings.description: Number of future EPG days to inspect for preferred channels.

settings.name: epgPrefillMaxEvents
settings.label: Maximum prefill events
settings.description: Maximum number of EPG events to queue per prefill run across all channels.

settings.name: epgPrefillMaxEventsPerService
settings.label: Maximum events per prefill service
settings.description: Maximum number of future EPG events inspected per service.

settings.name: epgUseZapHistory
settings.label: Use zap history
settings.description: Use preferred channels from zap/watch history for prefill decisions.

settings.name: epgZapHistoryTopN
settings.label: Zap history top channels
settings.description: Maximum number of preferred channels selected from zap/watch history.

settings.name: debugLog
settings.label: Log mode
settings.description: Off writes nothing. On writes real errors only. Verbose writes the full diagnostic log.

settings.name: logTarget
settings.label: Log output
settings.description: Choose whether e2MDB log lines are written to e2MDB.log, the Enigma2 debug log, or both.

settings.name: logRotateSizeMb
settings.label: e2MDB.log max size (MB)
settings.description: Rotate e2MDB.log when this size is reached.

settings.name: translateTitleSearch
settings.label: Google title translation fallback
settings.description: Translate only the title when normal provider search finds no result.

settings.name: translateTitleSearchLanguage
settings.label: Google title translation target language
settings.description: Target language for fallback search titles.

settings.name: providerEnglishTextFallback
settings.label: English metadata text fallback
settings.description: If the selected provider language returns artwork but no usable text, retry provider metadata once in English.

settings.name: translateMetadataFallback
settings.label: Translate English metadata fallback
settings.description: Translate overview and tagline from the English fallback into the selected provider language before storing them.

settings.name: epgCleanupSqliteVacuum
settings.label: SQLite VACUUM
settings.description: Shrink e2MDB SQLite database files during backend maintenance.

settings.name: epgCleanupSqliteReindex
settings.label: SQLite REINDEX
settings.description: Rebuild SQLite indexes during backend maintenance. Usually not needed.
